map.商品 y 价格变动对商品 x 需求量的影响。正为替代品，负为互补品。: The effect of a price change in good y on the quantity demanded of good x. Positive means substitutes, negative means complements.
map.📖 查看「交叉价格弹性计算器 使用指南」: 📖 Read the "Cross-Price Elasticity Calculator Usage Guide"
map.y 涨价、x 需求上升 → 替代品（正）。: If y gets pricier and demand for x rises, they are substitutes (positive).
map.关系判断：录入两商品量价变动，算交叉弹性，正为替代、负为互补。: Relationship test: enter the quantity and price changes of two goods and compute the cross elasticity; positive means substitutes, negative complements.
map.定价参考：对互补品提价看对自身需求的影响。: Pricing reference: raise the price of a complement to see the effect on your own demand.
map.教学演示：演示替代品交叉弹性为正、互补品为负。: Teaching demo: show that cross elasticity is positive for substitutes and negative for complements.
map.示例：B 价涨 10%、A 量增 5%，交叉弹性=0.5>0，A、B 为替代品。: Example: the price of B rises 10% and the quantity of A rises 5%, so cross elasticity = 0.5 > 0 and A and B are substitutes.
map.正=替代（一涨价另一需求升），负=互补（一涨价另一需求降），近 0 无关。结果仅: Positive = substitutes (a price rise for one lifts demand for the other), negative = complements (a price rise for one cuts demand for the other), near 0 = unrelated.
